text.p: Medical Polymers Technologies Inc said Friday that at a special meeting for shareholders this month it will seek approval for reorganization proposals related to its inability to pay interest due on a note secured from stockholders in 1995.
In a press release, Medical Polymers said that it has been unable to pay all interest due as of April 1, 1995 on the $797,000 note secured from 24 stockholders in 1995.

The company said it is seeking approval for the conversion of the note, including interest, to shares of common stock and will also seek cancellation of 3.2 million shares of escrowed performance stock.
Medical Polymers said it is also looking for approval of a one-for-seven reverse stock split and a change of the company's name to U.S. Medical Systems Inc.

After the reverse split, Medical Polymers would have about 1.2 million shares of common stock issued, adjusted for the escrow share cancellation, and would would be required to issues another 1.2 million post-split shares to settle the outstanding note.
